fragments.FRAME.AXIS_HEADLINE: From {window_start} to {window_end}, Rahu crosses {sign} while Ketu works the opposite sign — a transit that, for your chart, bears directly on career matters.
fragments.FRAME.LEAD_CONTACT: as Rahu crosses your {planet}, the planet most tied to your professional standing, that channel enters a visible build-up;
fragments.FRAME.DASHA_AGREES: and because the running sub-period belongs to this same channel, this touch speaks at full volume.
fragments.FRAME.DASHA_SILENT: the running sub-period does not yet echo this channel, so the full delivery waits for a period that does.
fragments.FRAME.TIMELINE: The build-up begins around {date_rise}, stands at its peak near {date_peak}, and has fully released by {date_release}.
fragments.ANSWER.FAVORABLE.CAREER: For career, this transit is favourable: the window around {date_peak} is when a move — promotion, role change, or recognition — has the strongest support.
fragments.ANSWER.MIXED.CAREER: For career, this transit is mixed: genuine openings exist, but they come attached to pressure that must be managed deliberately.
fragments.ANSWER.CHALLENGING.CAREER: For career, this transit asks for consolidation rather than bold moves; the support structures are thin until the window turns.
fragments.ANSWER.FAVORABLE.GENERIC: For the matter asked, this transit is favourable, with the strongest support near {date_peak}.
fragments.ANSWER.MIXED.GENERIC: For the matter asked, this transit is mixed — openings exist alongside pressure.
fragments.ANSWER.CHALLENGING.GENERIC: For the matter asked, this transit asks for patience and consolidation.
fragments.REASON.AXIS.BOTH_FAVORABLE: Both nodes occupy supportive houses from your Moon sign, so the general tide of the period runs with you.
fragments.REASON.AXIS.ONE_FAVORABLE: One node occupies a supportive house from your Moon sign, giving the period a working base of support.
fragments.REASON.LANDLORD.YOGAKARAKA: The lord of the sign Rahu crosses is your chart's yogakaraka — the transit is hosted by the planet best placed to deliver for you.
fragments.REASON.LANDLORD.STRONG: The lord of the sign Rahu crosses is strong, so the transit's promises have a capable host.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.STRONG.MOON: Your Moon — the mind and the public-facing self — is strong by position, so Rahu's touch amplifies rather than unsettles.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.STRONG.VENUS: Your Venus is strong by position, so Rahu's touch on it delivers gains through comfort, alliances, and creative capital.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.STRONG.SATURN: Your Saturn is strong by position, so Rahu's touch on it rewards discipline with visible, durable results.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.STRONG.MARS: Your Mars is strong by position, so Rahu's touch on it converts drive into decisive professional moves.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.SUPPORTIVE.MOON: The Moon carries a supportive functional role for your ascendant, so her contact works in your favour.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.SUPPORTIVE.VENUS: Venus carries a supportive functional role for your ascendant, so this contact works in your favour.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.SUPPORTIVE.SATURN: Saturn carries a supportive functional role for your ascendant, so this contact works in your favour.
fragments.REASON.CONTACT.SUPPORTIVE.MARS: Mars carries a supportive functional role for your ascendant, so this contact works in your favour.
fragments.REASON.DASHA.AGREES.MOON: The Moon's own sub-period runs at the contact's peak — the promise and the period point the same way.
fragments.REASON.DASHA.AGREES.VENUS: The running sub-period echoes Venus's channel at the contact's peak — promise and period point the same way.
fragments.REASON.DASHA.AGREES.SATURN: The running sub-period echoes Saturn's channel at the contact's peak — promise and period point the same way.
fragments.REASON.DASHA.AGREES.MARS: The running sub-period echoes Mars's channel at the contact's peak — promise and period point the same way.
fragments.REASON.ASPECT.BENEFIC_ON_RAHU.JUPITER: Jupiter aspects the transiting Rahu, softening the node's hunger into ambition with a workable plan.
fragments.CAUTION.AXIS.NEITHER_FAVORABLE: Neither node sits in a supportive house from your Moon sign, so the period's general tide does not carry you — results come only through the specific channels named.
fragments.CAUTION.LANDLORD.WEAK: The lord of the sign Rahu crosses is weak, so the transit's promises arrive reduced and delayed.
fragments.CAUTION.CONTACT.PRESSURE.MOON: Rahu crossing the Moon stirs restlessness and second-guessing; decisions taken in the peak weeks deserve a night's sleep before signing.
fragments.CAUTION.CONTACT.PRESSURE.SATURN: Rahu crossing Saturn compresses timelines and raises workload; protect health and do not over-commit in the peak weeks.
fragments.CAUTION.CONTACT.PRESSURE.MARS: Rahu crossing Mars heats temper and haste; avoid resignations or confrontations fired off in the peak weeks.
fragments.CAUTION.CONTACT.PRESSURE.VENUS: Rahu crossing Venus can inflate appetites and expenses; keep commitments proportionate in the peak weeks.
fragments.CAUTION.ASPECT.MALEFIC_ON_RAHU.SATURN: Saturn aspects the transiting Rahu, adding weight and delay to the node's push.
fragments.CAUTION.KETU.TENTH: Ketu moving through your 10th house can bring a quiet detachment from title and recognition even as results arrive; anchor yourself in the work itself.
